name: new-study
when: Setting up a study: dataset, queries, pools, labels, team.

steps.title: 1 · Dataset
steps.text: A dataset added on the command line.

steps.title: 2 · Encoding
steps.text: Which encoders have embedded the images and queries, and the command for what is missing.

steps.title: 3 · Queries
steps.text: One of its query sets: image, text or image + text queries, all or a random sample.

steps.title: 4 · Encoder and pools
steps.text: Choose an encoder, or none to judge every image on its own. Each query is judged against its given candidates, its k most similar images (from one encoder or several, fused), or a random sample of the collection.

steps.title: 5 · Labels
steps.text: Relevant and Not Relevant; Unsure is optional.

steps.title: 6 · Name and team
steps.text: Annotators judge, adjudicators set the final labels where annotators disagree, other admins help manage. Creating the study builds and groups the pools; the pilot comes next.
